steps.data: Read data.txt, then make exactly ONE Edit tool call on data.txt whose old_string is the 60 consecutive lines line-070 through line-129 and whose new_string is the same 60 lines with the word alpha replaced by OMEGA. Do not make any other edits and do not use Bash. After the edit reply with just: EDIT-DONE
Now reply with ONLY a fenced python code block of exactly 100 lines, no prose before or after. Line k (k = 1..100, zero-padded to 3 digits) must be: print("row-KKK stream check")

Now use the Agent tool (a.k.a. Task tool) to launch exactly 3 subagents in parallel in ONE message (subagent_type general-purpose, model haiku). Subagent 1 prompt: "Read data.txt and reply with only the full text of line-050." Subagent 2: the same but for line-150. Subagent 3: the same but for line-190. When all three finish, reply with exactly: SUBAGENTS-DONE

Now create a todo list with exactly 20 items using your todo/task tool (TodoWrite or TaskCreate): item N is "TODO-NN verify size policy step N" (NN zero-padded to 2 digits). Then mark TODO-01 as in progress. Do not do anything else. Finally reply with exactly: TODOS-DONE
